{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue column type and sample values
print(f"Revenue data type: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue values: {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check distribution of customer_segment
print(f"Customer segment distribution:\n{df['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check distribution of channel
print(f"Channel distribution:\n{df['channel'].value_counts()}")"}
